item.title: Verbal Order Read Back
item.author: worldwide@worldwidestew.com (Michael Davis)
item.description: When a doctor or Advance Practice Provider (like a Physician Assitant or Nurse Practitioner)issues a verbal order, the person taking the order is usually supposed to read it back to confirm understanding. Clinicians often feel its unncessary: We’re in a hurry.We’ve got things to do. Verbal order readback (VORB) is an invitation. It’s an invitation to reduce confusion or dispel doubts. With VORB, the person receiving the order and the person giving the order have the opportunity to dance.

item.title: Can I help you?
item.author: worldwide@worldwidestew.com (Michael Davis)
item.description: Offering help is a great start. But, to really help requires at least one more step.

item.title: The last thing they say before they leave
item.author: worldwide@worldwidestew.com (Michael Davis)
item.description: Too often, people wait until the very last second to say what they wanted, intended, and should have said the first thing.
